description: Contains only types and `declare` statements describing JavaScript that exists elsewhere.
Tells the compiler that a value exists at runtime without emitting any code for it.
DefinitelyTyped packages with community-maintained declarations, e.g. `@types/node`.
Lists global `@types` packages to include. Defaults to `[]` since TypeScript 6.0.
`declare module 'name' { ... }` describes a module that has no types of its own.
Reopens a library's interfaces with `declare module 'lib'` to add members.
Requires explicit export types so `.d.ts` files can be generated per file without type checking.
